title: Cursor
intro: raven.cursor selects an installed raster Xcursor theme and its size.

blocks.label: Cursor options
rows: Installed Xcursor theme name. Theme inheritance and fallback apply.
Positive whole-number size in logical pixels.

blocks.text: Theme and size reload together. If cursor preparation fails, the reload is rejected. SVG-only themes are not supported. Applications supplying their own cursor may render it differently.
